tools.name: lookup_host
tools.description: Cached host report. Free. Does not 402. Body includes cache.presenceStale, cache.callabilityStale, and refresh (payable live re-probe: priceUsd, network, rest.url, mcp.tool refresh_host). Does not re-probe.

tools.name: refresh_host
tools.description: Paid live re-probe named by lookup_host refresh.rest. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with x402Version and accepts. Price matches refresh.priceUsd ($0.02 USDC on Base by default). Vokko never pays the target.

tools.name: participation_check
tools.description: Cached participation status and evidence. Not a legal finding.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Newest-first drift. Anonymous: last 5 summaries. Subscriber for that origin: full history.

tools.name: refresh_host_protocol
tools.description: Paid live probe of one protocol. Args domain, protocol (ucp, mcp, a2a, x402, and the other detector ids). Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.005 USDC on Base. Full-host refresh_host stays $0.02.

tools.name: refresh_hosts_batch
tools.description: Paid live re-probe of up to 10 hosts. Args domains (string array) and mode "full". Unpaid calls return one HTTP 402. Price is $0.01 + $0.002 × N USDC on Base.

tools.name: find_payable
tools.description: Alphabetical hosts whose index row includes x402. Evidence only. Not a rank and not a payable proof.

tools.name: pay_preflight
tools.description: Can an agent pay at this host? Rails, endpoint, price, freshness. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

tools.name: endpoint_health
tools.description: Is this paid API up, and what does it charge right now? Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

tools.name: find_provider
tools.description: Cheapest live x402 providers for a task. Placement is never sold. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.005 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

tools.name: payto_check
tools.description: Does this payTo address belong to the domain? Evidence, not a guarantee. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.002 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Did this USDC transfer settle to the expected address and amount? Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

tools.name: seller_trust
tools.description: Observational x402 seller trust score for a payTo and network. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.
